candidate.question: Will the price of Bitcoin be above $72,000 on September 5?

decision.on_failure: Terminalize this exact candidate without retry, replacement, parameter change, or book request.
decision.on_pass: Freeze a separate one-use two-token book screen using only the retained exact source identities and settings.

purpose: Rejection-first exact-source reconciliation for one source-selected current BTC paired-maker liquidity-reward candidate before any book access.

exact_reward.operation: Get raw rewards for a specific market; public read-only documented endpoint.

gamma.operation: Discover markets by exact slug; public read-only documented endpoint.

retry.reopen_only_on: A materially new exact source-selected BTC/ETH/SOL reward market or a documented material change in this market's reward configuration; never by repeating this consumed candidate.
